steps.heading: Start with yellow.
steps.text: Use yellow as the main color in your next design.

steps.heading: Choose a contrasting color.
steps.text: Pair yellow with deep blue to make important details stand out.

steps.heading: Add your imagery.
steps.text: Place a photo beside your yellow background and check that its subject remains easy to see.

steps.heading: Refine your design.
steps.text: Keep headings clear, leave space around your content, and use the same yellow consistently across your design.

steps.heading: Share your yellow design.
steps.text: Review your finished design before sharing it with your audience.

data.heading: How to use black.

steps.heading: Start with black.
steps.text: Use black as the main color in your next design.

steps.heading: Choose a contrasting color.
steps.text: Pair black with white to keep your content easy to read.

steps.heading: Add your imagery.
steps.text: Choose a photo that remains clear against a black background.

steps.heading: Refine your design.
steps.text: Leave space around your headings and check that every detail is visible.

steps.heading: Share your black design.
steps.text: Review your finished design before sharing it with your audience.

steps.heading: Combine jade with other colors.
steps.text: Pair jade with warm neutrals for a balanced palette. Use a dark accent for headings, leave generous space around your content, and repeat the same jade across your background, illustrations, and small details so the finished design feels consistent.

steps.heading: Explore the character of jade.
steps.text: Use jade to give your design a fresh, nature-inspired feel.

steps.heading: Compare jade and emerald.
steps.text: Compare the two greens side by side before choosing the shade for your design.

steps.heading: Finish your jade design.
steps.text: Check your palette and share your finished work.
